q.en: Name the ten digital/social media options.

a.en: Email, messaging, web content, podcasting, social networks, information sharing sites, content sharing sites, wikis, blogging/microblogging, online video.
a.ms: E-mel, pemesejan, kandungan web, podcast, rangkaian sosial, laman perkongsian maklumat, laman perkongsian kandungan, wiki, blog/mikroblog, video.

a.en: Formal impression, legal compliance, stand out from digital flood, permanent/unchangeable/secure record.
a.ms: Kesan formal, pematuhan undang-undang, menonjol, rekod kekal/tidak berubah/selamat.

a.en: Conversations, comments and critiques, orientations, summaries, reference material, narratives, teasers, status updates and announcements, tutorials.
a.ms: Perbualan, komen dan kritikan, orientasi, ringkasan, rujukan, naratif, teaser, kemas kini status, tutorial.

a.en: Location-based services, gamification, augmented reality, wearables, mobile blogging, mobile podcasting, cloud services.
a.ms: Perkhidmatan lokasi, gamifikasi, AR, boleh pakai, blog mudah alih, podcast mudah alih, awan.

a.en: Universal, private, accommodates longer messages, (not instantaneous/scheduling/access are listed on the slide).
a.ms: Universal, peribadi, muat mesej panjang, (tidak serta-merta/penjadualan/akses disenaraikan pada slaid).

a.en: Alternatives available, indiscriminate use, low-value messages, spam, computer viruses, phishing.
a.ms: Wujud alternatif, penggunaan tanpa pilih, mesej bernilai rendah, spam, virus, phishing.

a.en: Valid business purpose, comply with employer policies and ethics, use planning process.
a.ms: Tujuan perniagaan sah, patuhi dasar dan etika, guna proses perancangan.

a.en: Higher expectation of quality, informative subject lines, opening words extend subject, use emoticons sparingly.
a.ms: Jangkaan kualiti tinggi, subjek bermaklumat, perkataan pembuka lanjut subjek, emotikon jarang.

a.en: Think twice before sending, revise, proofread, careful with Reply All, avoid high priority unless necessary.
a.ms: Fikir dua kali, semak, semak bukti, hati-hati Reply All, elak keutamaan tinggi.

a.en: Mimics voice conversation, can choose participants, less overload and security problems.
a.ms: Meniru perbualan suara, pilih peserta, kurang beban dan masalah keselamatan.

a.en: Can be annoyingly slow, systems vary in security and privacy, increased risk of miscommunication.
a.ms: Boleh perlahan, sistem beza keselamatan dan privasi, risiko salah faham.

a.en: Be courteous, short simple messages, no confidential information, focus on one conversation, security guidelines.
a.ms: Sopan, mesej pendek, tiada maklumat sulit, fokus satu perbualan, garis panduan keselamatan.

q.en: Why is website content hard to organise?

a.en: Multiple purposes and audiences make planning and organisation difficult.
a.ms: Pelbagai tujuan dan audiens menyukarkan perancangan dan penyusunan.

a.en: A three-dimensional outline of a website: vertical hierarchy, horizontal division and links tying pages together; there is no beginning, middle or end.
a.ms: Rangka tiga dimensi laman web: hierarki menegak, pembahagian mendatar, pautan; tiada permulaan, tengah, penghujung.

a.en: Brainstorm usage, identify entry points, map, easy return to top, search options, consistent labels.
a.ms: Sumbang saran penggunaan, titik masuk, peta, mudah kembali, carian, label konsisten.

a.en: Build trust, inverted pyramid, readable chunks, skimmable, concise link names, global audience.
a.ms: Bina kepercayaan, piramid terbalik, bahagian mudah dibaca, imbas, pautan ringkas, audiens global.

a.en: Plan (analyse, gather, organise); write (beginning-middle-end, scripts vs outlines, in advance); complete (revise/edit, record, distribute).
a.ms: Rancang (analisis, kumpul, susun); tulis (permulaan-tengah-penghujung, skrip lwn rangka, awal); lengkapkan (semak/sunting, rakam, edar).
